plan: Since my private value for the item is $0, any bid would result in a guaranteed loss if I win because I would pay the third-highest bid without gaining any value. Therefore, the optimal strategy is to bid $0, ensuring I don't win and thus preserve my entire endowment of $49.

Given my private value of $10, I will bid conservatively to maximize profit. Since bids must be in $0.1 increments, I aim to bid slightly higher than the expected third-highest bid. Assuming the other bids range between $0-$49, a bid of $5.1 is reasonable. This strategy minimizes potential loss if I win, as I would pay the third-highest bid, likely lower than $5.1. If I lose, I preserve most of my endowment.

My private value is $28. To ensure a profit, I should bid below $28, ideally around $20 to $25. This maximizes the chance of winning while ensuring a profit if I win, as the third-highest bid will likely be lower. Since there's no history, I assume others will bid near their values. A bid of $24 offers a balance between winning probability and profit margin, as it is close enough to my value but below it to ensure a gain if I win.
